Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Our No Makeup Makeup® Foundation is a lightweight cream that evens out your skin without looking heavy or cakey. The Perfect Foundation Brush helps blend it in for a seamless, natural finish. Our Blush & Lip Color is a multipurpose cream that gives your cheeks and lips a healthy flush—just dab on with your fingers or a brush.
